videos.script_day-1: Tap into people’s curiosity. Document your beginnings and the moments you spend preparing your product.
videos.script_day-10: Document the first order in every detail: the hard work, late nights, and joy. Genuine emotional moments attract people and encourage them to order from your store.
videos.script_day-2: Answer a question people are searching for. Helpful content reaches people faster than content that sells.
videos.script_day-3: Do not sell directly. Start with something that sparks the viewer’s curiosity, such as forbidden things or common mistakes, then connect it to your product.
videos.script_day-4: Not everyone who sees your product needs it. Speak to those who do not need it and suggest gifting it to someone dear to them.
videos.script_day-5: Let customers see every detail of your product. Close-up, professional shots build trust faster than any words.
videos.script_day-6: Do not start with the product. Start with the problem and amplify it. When viewers feel that they experience it, your product becomes the natural solution.
videos.script_day-7: Go out and ask people questions. Whoever answers correctly wins your product, while viewers keep watching because they either know the answer or want to find it out.
videos.script_day-8: Instead of listing your product’s benefits, test it on camera and let viewers judge for themselves.
videos.script_day-9: Show your product directly and present your offer clearly. Customers want to know what they get without any runaround.
